title: WizardApplyPayload
description: Discriminated-union payload for /api/apply on the unified Installer + Setup-Wizard. Locks the contract decided in road-to-global-only-install Phase 0.4 (D12). schema_version selects the variant.

InstallerPayloadV1.description: Legacy Installer-GUI payload — AI tools + per-tool configs only. Settings + packs not yet merged.

ai_tools.description: Tool IDs as listed in dist/discovery/discovery-manifest.json (e.g. claude-code, cursor, augment).

configs.description: Per-tool config bags; opaque to the schema, validated by the installer.

WizardPayloadV2.description: Unified Setup-Wizard payload — AI tools + packs + settings in one envelope. Used by the 9-step wizard.

packs.description: Pack IDs from dist/discovery/discovery-manifest.json. Empty = base package only.

settings.description: Merged .agent-settings.yml + .agent-user.yml body. The wizard collects these in Steps 3-9; the installer atomically writes them to the global scope.

scope_to_project_only.description: Step 9 (Review) checkbox. When true the settings are written to the project tree instead of the global location. Off by default per D8.
